replicate_statements: The band intensity was quantified and is shown in the lower graphs.
The data are presented as mean ± SD.
N=4 (shown on the mitochondrial fraction graph)
outputs.explanation: The panel shows quantified band-intensity bar graphs with mean ± SD and statistical tests (t-test, ANOVA+Tukey's HSD), so replicate reporting is required. An 'N=4' is printed only next to the mitochondrial-fraction graph, leaving it unclear whether this n also applies to the nuclear and cytosolic fraction quantifications. Critically, the caption/figure never states what the n=4 units are (e.g., mice/animals, independent blots, or biological replicates), so the type of replicate is not reported.

This panel presents representative immunoelectron microscopy images used to support a generalizable observation about HMGB1 localization, but the caption gives no indication of how many animals, sections, or fields were examined to arrive at this conclusion. Neither the number nor the type of replicate (e.g., 'n = 3 mice' or 'representative of n independent experiments') is stated.

This is a single western blot comparing five samples/purification methods to demonstrate presence of HMGB1 in mitochondria. No statement is given as to whether this blot is representative of multiple independent experiments, and no replicate number or type is reported in the caption.

The proteinase K protection assay is shown as a single western blot without any statement of the number of independent experiments performed or the type of replicate. No 'n =' or 'representative of n experiments' language is present in the caption.
